rationale: Both role-isolated advisory inputs were present from distinct runs and model families, pinned to the same frozen candidate. The academic review returned request-changes with one blocking finding, three major, three minor and one verification note; the learning-design review approved with five notes. The blocking finding cannot be waived under this policy and was not: it is repaired here, and it was right. The lesson was arguing with itself. Scene 4 already taught that a structural criterion met an organism sitting on the line and that ancestry, not membrane-counting, settled it, while the objective, the scene 1 definition, the diagram, the glossary and four answer keys still asked the learner to classify any cell from DNA location alone. The repair states the test's standing rather than weakening it, because the test is the right place for a learner to start; it is the working criterion, it describes construction, and ancestry decides membership. Two further consequences fell out of that finding: the separation of transcription from translation is a property of nuclear genes and not of mitochondrial ones, and the lesson needed a fourth tier, because transcript processing and quality control are made possible by the separation rather than caused by it. That tier is now taught, diagrammed and assessed, which makes the lesson's own sorting discipline apply to the lesson. The three majors were all answer keys: a tier error inside the item that teaches tiers, false precision converting a characteristic diffusion time into a crossing latency, and a per-cell ploidy error that halved the replication work the learner was asked to explain, alongside a causal chain from the criterion to cycle duration that the criterion does not entail. The academic verdict stands as dissent and no reviewer has seen the repaired text.
dissent: The academic review's request-changes verdict stands as material dissent from the candidate as reviewed. Its findings were incorporated by the maintainer afterwards; no reviewer has approved the repaired text, and the blocking finding's repair is the largest single change made to any pack in this block without a reviewer seeing the result.

The blocking finding also noted that the universal wording had no answer for enucleated eukaryotic cells. That half is addressed by scoping the claim rather than by teaching the case, because no source in this pack establishes it and no retrieval was performed during finalization. The lesson now says the test is not expected to answer for every cell in a body, and says no more than that. A reader who wants the case taught is right to want it; it is a gap left open deliberately rather than an oversight.

Adding a fourth tier is a structural change to the lesson's central model, made in a finalization pass on the strength of one reviewer's finding. It is defensible because the model was already inconsistent with its own claim ledger and with scene 3's prose, but a fresh review of the four-tier version would be worth having before this pack leaves 0.1.0.

reviewDispositions.rationale: lesson.json, content/01-two-ways-to-build-a-cell.md, content/03-a-room-of-its-own.md, content/04-older-simpler-lesser.md, diagrams/what-the-criterion-licenses.diagram.json, glossary.json and assessment.json: the criterion is stated as the working test it is, not a definition of membership; group membership is attributed to ancestry throughout; the direct consequences are scoped to nuclear genes with mitochondrial genes named as outside the arrangement; and a fourth made-possible tier is taught, diagrammed and assessed. assessment.json: item-sort-what-follows now states the direct consequence as a nuclear transcript needing to cross before it is read, and carries transcript quality control as a separate made-possible option the learner should leave unselected.

assessment.json: item-diffusion-crossing-time asks for a characteristic time and says what it is not, the tolerance is loosened from 0.8 to 1.5 seconds, and the key states that diffusion has no arrival time and the relation supports an order of magnitude.

assessment.json: item-generation-time-account uses the diploid per-cell figure of roughly six billion base pairs across 46 chromosome copies, and states that genome size, linear chromosomes and mitotic architecture travel with the architecture rather than being entailed by it.

content/01-two-ways-to-build-a-cell.md: the capsule, plasmid, pili and flagellum are labels for reading the figure, with their functions explicitly not established in this pack, since claim-prokaryote-cell-features does not cover them.

claims.json and content/06-why-one-culture-takes-six-weeks.md: the timings are attributed to the 2014 study rather than to current tools, molecular testing is named as leading initial diagnosis while culture and phenotypic susceptibility stay slow, and the meaning of an interim negative is made conditional on specimen, burden, system and method.
